description: Source code for semaphore and mutex handling in an embedded system, including functions for waiting and signaling semaphores, initializing semaphores, and placeholder functions for mutex operations.

methods.name: WaitSemaphore
methods.description: Decrements semaphore value; if negative, puts caller in waiting state or handles timeout.

methods.name: SignalSemaphore
methods.description: Increments semaphore value; if there are waiting tasks, makes the first ready.

methods.name: InitSemaphore
methods.description: Initializes semaphore with a given count and prepares task queue.

methods.name: WaitMutex
methods.description: Placeholder for mutex wait operation, currently returns success.

methods.name: ReleaseMutex
methods.description: Placeholder for mutex release operation, currently returns success.
